map_create.fact: map base +0x28 is set to dword zero and map base +0x2c to dword one

insert.fact: when map+0x2c is nonzero, writes zero to allocated entry WORD +0x28; map dword +0x28 separately receives range-size addition

split.fact: copies 11 dwords, covering entry bytes through +0x2b

pageable_down.fact: loads entry word, decrements and stores it; old value one selects _vm_fault_unwire

pageable_up.fact: loads entry word, increments and stores it; old value zero selects later setup path

clear.fact: unwire/delete paths write entry WORD +0x28 to zero

limit: No unsigned-wrap, synchronization, or complete alias/lifetime claim is made.
